review_note: Read the test and helpers. Independent base-R dense Laplace oracle with a hand Henderson A (inbred pedigree, diag(A) > 1.6), a hand relmat kernel and Ainv/Q by solve(). For probit and cloglog the oracle uses its own stable derivative code (sb26_deriv_binary), not the package's. All 12 row_keys are fitted: animal {A, Ainv, pedigree} x relmat {K, Q} for each of the two links, 6 fits per link on one fixture per link. In every fit logLik agrees with the oracle within 1e-4, and the six oracle values per link agree within 1e-6. Each emulated bug (swapped selector coefficients, reversed SD, cov2cor(K) for both fields, K x 2, kernel read by position) is asserted to move the oracle by more than 0.1. Fields are intercept-only on separate factors with sd ~ z, so there is no slope-member issue. Manifest and receipt/test sha256 values match the current files. Console shows 230 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped, exit 0, and no Julia is involved. Does NOT establish: logit animal+relmat (covered by another receipt); calibration, coverage, SE or recovery (the true SDs are boosted per field only to give information); parity with Julia; any seed beyond the two fixed ones (one per link); behaviour away from the fitted optimum; slope or correlated random effects.
